description: Fixed faults independent of inspected audio and production engine. No optimization on reserved meeting. Engine runs on original 16 kHz PCM for corpus metrics; separate project/resource integration uses 48 kHz ingestion.
automatic_acceptance: None. Harness explicitly marks all donor proposals accepted to test rendering; reported review_accepted does not imply automatic user acceptance.
interpretation: Fixed intervals can contain silence, overlap or another speaker. Count overlap with injected faults, never classify every miss as missing speech. Clean proposals have no organic-damage adjudication and are called unrequested proposals, not verified false positives.
